text:
matt: Quick heads-up — scheduling a short overnight maintenance to probe a subtle egress queue tweak + a NIC microcode sanity check on the surge GPU pool. Window: Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. Expect staged node drains, warm KV cache reseed, and brief p95 bumps.

sara: +1. Which pools exactly?

matt: target: gpu-pool-surge-{a,b,c} (priority: a -> b -> c). We'll cordon 2 racks at a time, drain tasks with graceful 5m timeout, then soft reboot NICs.

kai: Will this trigger tenant failovers? We should ensure Dedicated customers on those racks get fallback to reserved pools.

matt: Good call — routing policy will shift tenant traffic to reserved-standby in the same region. No cross-region failover unless backfill fails.

infra-bot: Incident stub created: INC-2026-4589 (link: https://ops.redwood.internal/inc/INC-2026-4589) — page will go out at 02:50 UTC.

jonah: Who's running the canary? I can take the first cohort at 03:05. Need a second eyes for KV cache validation.

matt: Thanks — jonah you run canary a. I'll monitor per-model p50/p95 and cost-meter. kai pls hold the rollback playbook. ops-lead pls coordinate on-call.

ops-lead: Got it. I'll be on-call and watching SLA channels. Pls post the quick rollback steps in thread.

matt: Rollback checklist (short):
```
- stop drain: infractl drain cancel <node-list>
- uncordon: kubectl uncordon <node>
- traffic rollback: routingctl set-policy region=eu1 policy=normal
- KV cache warm: infractl kvseed --pool gpu-pool-surge-a --parallel=4
```

sara: Any expected quota/cost hit for backfilling to reserved-standby? We should estimate.

matt: Short answer: ~8-12% additional hourly GPU cost during 03:00-04:00 if we backfill at peak. I'll attach a quick calc after the first canary.

jonah: Canary notes: we'll run 20 synthetic requests (long-tail seq=4096) and watch token-per-sec, memory, and p95. If p95 > baseline + 30% or error-rate > 0.5%, abort.

kai: Add network egress health check: run `iperf3` between racks and watch retransmits. If retransmits spike, abort.

infra-bot: Deploy job queued: nic-microcode-softflip v1.0 -> cohort-a (ETA 03:20 UTC).

matt: Communication plan:
- 02:50 UTC: outbound page + status channel message
- 03:00 UTC: start canary cohort-a (jonah)
- 03:20 UTC: evaluate, if green continue cohort-b at 03:30, cohort-c at 03:50
- 04:30 UTC: final verification, uncordon any held nodes

ops-lead: I'll prepare a short public note for customers in case we see longer p95 regressions. Keep it under 2 lines.

sara: One last ask — please run the KV cache seed on standby pools before we start so backfill is fast. Use parallel=6 if possible.

matt: Will do. Command I'll run just before 02:45: `infractl kvseed --pool reserved-standby-eu1 --parallel=6`

jonah: I'll post canary logs here and a short pass/fail message.

matt: Thanks everyone. I'll update INC-2026-4589 with results post windows. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: INC-2026-4589 status: scheduled -> in_progress (03:05 UTC).
